verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a desktop Linux distribution, so shipping a built-in password and passkey manager is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a password manager or passkey tool. The documented security features (mandatory full-disk encryption, a default firewall) are adjacent controls and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage passwords and passkeys using a built-in privacy and security tool
